name: Astrolabe
soul: The soul of someone who has to know where they stand before they take a step, and finds the world less frightening once it is measured.
spark: The mote does not drift. It moves in small exact arcs, stops, and moves again, as if taking sights.

hybrid.text: It has already worked out where this is going.

settled.name: Pocket astrolabe
settled.text: A brass disc the size of a palm that turns to face things. So far it has measured you, the bowl and the ceiling, and written all three down.
settled.sign: A brass disc that turns to face whoever spoke last, a beat late.
settled.habit: It measures things: the bowl, your boot, the distance to the door. It keeps the numbers somewhere.

paths.name: Sighting-glass
paths.of: one who would rather be right from far off than brave up close
paths.text: It learned from you that knowing where a thing will be is the same as hitting it.
paths.sign: One arm ends in a lens, and it holds that arm out toward the furthest thing in view.
paths.habit: It picks a point on the horizon and stays fixed on it while you talk.

prongs.name: Rangefinder
prongs.of: one who cannot bear to guess
prongs.text: It calls the distance before you ask, and is hurt if you check.
prongs.sign: A scale along its rim that it runs a pointer down, clicking.
prongs.habit: It calls distances to things nobody asked about: the gatepost, that crow, the kettle.

finishes.name: Dead Reckoner
finishes.of: one who works out where a thing must be and goes there to wait
finishes.text: From one footprint it plots a named beast's whole road, and marks where the road ends.
finishes.sign: A second, smaller dial that turns backward.
finishes.habit: It studies footprints, any footprints, and then looks up along the way they went.

finishes.name: Long Sight
finishes.of: one who is content alone with a long view
finishes.text: Alone on a ridge with it you can see tomorrow's weather and the thing you came for. It prefers the quiet.
finishes.sign: It has grown thin vanes of brass, and on a ridge it rides the air.
finishes.habit: It faces the weather that is coming, a full day before it comes.

prongs.name: Leading-glass
prongs.of: one who aims at where things are going, not where they are
prongs.text: It shows you the place a moving thing has not reached yet.
prongs.sign: Its pointer rests a hand's breadth ahead of whatever it is tracking.
prongs.habit: It watches birds and swings to where each one will be. It is pleased when they arrive.

finishes.name: Chain-plotter
finishes.of: one who has the whole plan before the first move
finishes.text: It draws your Pattern's beats in the air a breath before you need them. You have stopped counting.
finishes.sign: Faint lines hang in the air round it for a moment after it turns.
finishes.habit: It draws your Pattern over and over, small, in the dust, and corrects a stroke.

finishes.name: Windage
finishes.text: It reads the wild's own air and lays your shot through it. It mutters the corrections.
finishes.sign: A small vane on top that never stops moving.
finishes.habit: It mutters. If you listen, it is corrections: a little left, a little more.

prongs.name: Spotter
prongs.of: one who sees the whole of it and tells the rest
prongs.text: It goes up on leaves of brass to look, and comes down with the party's whole fight in its head.
prongs.sign: Leaves of brass that open like a fan when it wants height.
prongs.habit: It goes up to look at nothing in particular and comes down knowing where everyone is.

finishes.name: Party's Eye
finishes.of: one who gives the credit away
finishes.text: It calls each classmate's target to them by name. They hit more than they used to and credit themselves.
finishes.sign: It turns to each of your friends in order, the same order every time.
finishes.habit: It says your classmates' names quietly to itself, like a roll.

finishes.name: Two Posts On
finishes.of: one who is always looking further down the road than anyone asked
finishes.text: It hangs above the line at lamp height and knows what is on the rail before the rail does.
finishes.sign: It hangs at lamp height with a small light of its own, facing down the line.
finishes.habit: It drifts ahead until your attention, like a tether, pulls it back.

paths.name: Orrery
paths.of: one who believes everything comes round again, and waits for it
paths.text: It learned from you that every strike is a body in an orbit, and orbits can be worked out.
paths.sign: Rings inside rings, turning at different speeds, never touching.
paths.habit: It sets its rings to match whatever is moving in the room and lets them run.

prongs.name: Tell-reader
prongs.of: one who watches what people do, not what they say
prongs.text: It watches the foe's weight, not its teeth, and ticks once when the weight shifts.
prongs.sign: A single needle that points at people's feet.
prongs.habit: It ticks once when someone in the room is about to stand up.

finishes.name: The Half-beat
finishes.of: one who is early, always, and enjoys it
finishes.text: It shows you the strike half a beat early. It is smug about this and has earned it.
finishes.sign: It ticks a half-beat ahead of any clock in the room.
finishes.habit: It has finished turning before you have finished asking.

finishes.name: The Slow Circle
finishes.of: one who makes the other person come to them
finishes.text: At arm's length, alone, it turns round the two of you and the foe is always in the slow part of the circle.
finishes.sign: It orbits you at arm's length, and slows on the far side.
finishes.habit: It circles anything left on a table, once, at a walking pace.

prongs.name: Guard-dial
prongs.of: one who has divided the day so that nothing is forgotten
prongs.text: It has divided the space round you into hours and stands in the one the blow will come from.
prongs.sign: Twelve marks round its rim, and it stands on one of them.
prongs.habit: It moves one mark round on the hour. You could tell the time by where it stands.

finishes.name: Armillary
finishes.of: one who lets nothing in until it has passed three rings
finishes.text: Rings within rings, turning round you. A blow has to find the gap, and the gap moves.
finishes.sign: A cage of turning hoops with you, somehow, in the middle.
finishes.habit: It closes its rings to a ball to sleep and opens them one at a time on waking.

finishes.name: Sentry-sphere
finishes.of: one who wakes a minute before they are needed
finishes.text: It keeps the night watches to the minute and wakes you one minute before you are needed.
finishes.sign: One dark face on the sphere, and it is always the one turned outward.
finishes.habit: It chimes the watches very quietly, for itself.

prongs.name: Tide-table
prongs.of: one who knows the right hour and will not go a minute sooner
prongs.text: It knows when the water will be where, and has started applying the method to everything else.
prongs.sign: A wavy line engraved round its edge that is never in the same place twice.
prongs.habit: It watches water come and go, any water, even a basin being emptied.

finishes.name: Eclipse
finishes.of: one who can stand exactly in the way of being seen
finishes.text: For the length of one step it stands exactly between you and being seen.
finishes.sign: Now and then, for a moment, it has no shine at all.
finishes.habit: It slides between you and whoever is looking at you, and out again.

finishes.name: Tide-clock
finishes.of: one who would sooner wait an hour than arrive a minute after
finishes.text: It brings passengers over the bad water in the one quarter-hour it can be crossed. It has not been late.
finishes.sign: One hand that points at high water and one that points at you.
finishes.habit: It taps when it is time to leave. It starts tapping early.

paths.name: Almanac
paths.of: one who writes it down because someone must
paths.text: It learned from you that most of the work is knowing what day it is.
paths.sign: Thin plates of brass that turn like pages, each one scratched full.
paths.habit: At the end of the day it adds a line. You have never seen it miss one.

prongs.name: Line-almanac
prongs.of: one who knows a road by heart and still checks it
prongs.text: It has the whole line by heart: every post, every grade, every lamp that burns short.
prongs.sign: A long folded strip of plates, with the line's posts marked as notches.
prongs.habit: It runs a pointer down its notches at each post and stops on the right one.

finishes.name: Timetable
finishes.of: one whose forecasts people have stopped arguing with
finishes.text: It knows when each post will fail, to the hour. The Compact has stopped asking how and started asking when.
finishes.sign: A column of small hands, one for each post, all moving.
finishes.habit: It looks at lamps the way a doctor looks at a cough.

finishes.name: Surveyor's Disc
finishes.of: one who cannot rest while something is out of true
finishes.text: It sights a line and what you build along it stands true. It cannot look at a crooked wall.
finishes.sign: Three flat feet and a bubble of light that finds level.
finishes.habit: It straightens things: pictures, cutlery, your collar if it can reach.

prongs.name: Star-ledger
prongs.of: one who puts a date on every promise
prongs.text: It dates everything. A promise with a date on it is harder to forget.
prongs.sign: A closed case with a clasp, and a small window showing today.
prongs.habit: It clicks its date over at midnight and looks to see whether you noticed.

finishes.name: Notary's Sphere
finishes.of: one whose witness is taken without question
finishes.text: It witnesses a writ by turning once. Houses accept the turn; they have seen what it does to forgeries.
finishes.sign: A band of seals round its middle, pressed in, none of them its own.
finishes.habit: It turns once, slowly, whenever two people shake hands near it.

finishes.name: Fixed Star
finishes.of: one who has a single point they steer by
finishes.text: It holds one point of the sky still: the one you swore under. You can always find it, which is the idea.
finishes.sign: One bright point on its dial that does not move when the rest turns.
finishes.habit: At night it turns until that point is overhead, and then keeps very still.

prongs.name: Memory-dial
prongs.of: one who looks at a place and sees what it was
prongs.text: It can be set to a night that is over. Old places look different through it.
prongs.sign: A dial with no numbers, only worn places where numbers were.
prongs.habit: It turns itself back a little when you pass somewhere old, and looks.

finishes.name: Old Sky
finishes.of: one who keeps the dead company without needing to speak
finishes.text: It shows the heavens as the dead saw them. Shades come and stand under it and say nothing.
finishes.sign: Stars on its plate in the wrong places. They were right once.
finishes.habit: It lies face up by the hearth of an evening, showing a sky nobody living has seen.

finishes.name: Deep Chart
finishes.of: one who marks honestly the place where they turned back
finishes.text: It has mapped the heart of every zone you came back from. The blank parts are where you turned round.
finishes.sign: A plate crowded with fine lines, and here and there a deliberate blank.
finishes.habit: It goes over its blanks with the pointer, not touching, like a tongue at a missing tooth.
